purpose: Audit contract for bounded multi-objective candidate generation, hard-constraint filtering, stress-test evaluation and Pareto promotion across InterSol assemblies. A receipt is analysis provenance, not engineering certification.
validation_rules: A candidate with any failed hard safety/compliance constraint cannot be PARETO_CANDIDATE or promoted.
Owner/aesthetic weights may only be applied after technical admissibility; they cannot convert HARD_FAIL into an acceptable state.
Unknown or unavailable engineering inputs remain null/unknown and must not be replaced with guessed values.
Every numerical metric must carry a units basis, evidence/model source and current geometry/configuration identity.
Stress-test outputs are provisional until the relevant discipline model and inputs are professionally reviewed.
Promotion of a derived design does not create construction approval, certification, licence or operational authority.
Any source geometry/configuration, applicable-standard, site/hazard or material change triggers revalidation.
